title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Cases concerning Marriage Registration
full_text:
Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Cases concerning Marriage Registration

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe the scope of matters concerning combat or official duties performed for the conduct of combat pursuant to Article 5 of the Act on Special Cases concerning Marriage Registration (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").

Article 2 (Meaning of Combat, etc.)
The expression "engaged in combat or in official duties for the conduct of combat" in Article 1 of the Act means that a member of the armed forces, a civilian employee of the armed forces, a police officer, a reservist, or a person mobilized for wartime labor performs any of the following acts: [Amended on November 29, 2016.]
1. Engaging in combat against an enemy or an anti-state organization pursuant to an operational order;
2. Engaging in combat to suppress an armed uprising;
3. Supporting any of the acts prescribed in subparagraphs 1 and 2.

Addendum <Presidential Decree No. 3952, May 30, 1969>
This Decree shall apply from December 31, 1968.

Addendum to the Enforcement Decree of the Reserve Forces Act <Presidential Decree No. 27619, November 29, 2016>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. [Proviso omitted.]

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (16) Omitted.
(17) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Cases concerning Marriage Registration shall be amended as follows:
In the portion of Article 2 other than its subparagraphs, "Homeland Reserve Forces" shall be replaced by "Reserve Forces".

Article 4
Omitted.
